messages:
maria: Quick design pass on playground streaming UI. Main frictions: stop/pause semantics unclear, token counter steals attention, prompt library peek hides the live stream. figma: https://figma.com/file/playground-stream-mini
sam: Which two should we fix for beta?
maria: 1) make Stop vs Pause explicit in copy + behavior. 2) lower token counter visual weight during active streaming.
alex: Dev note: Stop currently cancels hard. Pause is resumeable. I can split actions but need copy and a small state diagram. Also we should debounce token updates to 1s to avoid render churn.
aria: Accessibility: set aria-live="polite" on the stream; do NOT make token counter a live region. Ensure Stop has an accessible name like "Stop generation (discard partial)".
maria: Copy proposal: keep short labels ("Stop", "Pause") and add tooltips: "Stop: discard current output" / "Pause: pause and resume".
sam: Short labels + tooltips sound good. We'll A/B with explicit labels later.
alex: For destructive Stop, avoid blocking mobile modals. Use toast: "Generation stopped — Undo" (5s) and log undo events.
aria: Toast must receive focus and have keyboard-accessible Undo. Also announce the toast to screen readers.
maria: Token counter: default inline low-density under prompt; optional floating pill via user settings for power users.
sam: Default low-density + settings toggle. Track toggle adoption.
alex: I'll add toggle, debounce, and persistence.
aria: Prompt library peek currently pushes stream out of view. Proposal: split panel on desktop, overlay on small screens so stream controls stay visible.
alex: Implement split >=1024px, overlay otherwise.
ci-bot: branch 'playground/stream-ux-toggles' created with initial copy and aria changes. CI passing.
maria: I'll update Figma with tooltip states and the toast. Assign follow-ups: @alex implement toggles+undo+debounce; @aria run a11y tests; @sam wire metrics (stop vs pause, token toggle, prompt-open-rate).
sam: I'll add analytics events and dashboard views. ETA next Wednesday.
alex: PR incoming with screenshots.
aria: I'll run axe and NVDA checks after the branch is staged.
maria: Thanks team — small changes, big clarity improvements. :sparkles:
